info.title: dimos server (from dimOS Desktop openapi)
info.x-copied-from: GET /api/desktop/openapi of dimOS Desktop 0.2.2 (jeff/agent_chat, at or after the coded launch steps/problems), 2026-10-05, /dimos paths only. Kept as the only check that this server serves what Desktop documents, until Desktop's CI compares its doc against dimos's dimos/gateway/openapi.json (which it reads per tag anyway).

get.description: Where dimos keeps its things: the checkout, run registry, log folders, recordings folder.

200.description: `{ dimosDir, runsDir, logsDirs, recordingsDir, server: { exe, exeModified, kind, startedAt, zenohNamespace } }` (whose server answers, `dimos` or `builtin`, and what it runs; Desktop restarts its built-in server when that binary has been replaced and dimos's own when the checkout's dimos/gateway/ or dimos.yaml is newer than startedAt, and relays the server's events onto zenoh only when zenohNamespace isn't its own namespace)

post.description: Launch a blueprint (stops nothing; check /dimos/runs first).

overrides.description: this launch's own config on top of Desktop's saved config: {"global": {"simulation": "mujoco"}, "modules": {"go2connection": {"lidar": false}}} (a flat {key: value} means global; null drops a saved value); checked against dimos's schemas, 400 on an unknown name or a wrong type

200.description: `Launch`: `{ blueprint, phase, startedAt, pid, output, runId, logDir, error, overrides, steps: [{ code, state: done|now|todo|failed, data }], problems: [{ code, level, message, data, timestamp, logger }], modules: { module: { field: value } }, oneOff: { global, modules, secrets? } }`
